design.status: Exploratory menu fixed after earlier analyses; this is not preregistered or fresh confirmation.
design.source: Original interview dataset, original saved smoothed current-year ghost measure; no Loujaina data or new labels.
design.primary_ghost: Saved p_it_ebayes at year t, unchanged. Its original smoothing uses full company history; these tests are associations, not a real-time ghost-score forecasting exercise.

design.subgroup_rule: Annual medians use eligible activity panel, never future outcomes; ties are in lower group. Growth uses t versus t-1 financial information. Missing moderator is missing, not the low group.
design.controls: Original operating-change control set: current changes in oiadp, sale, xsga, emp, capx scaled by previous assets, plus original notebook book-to-market construction. Retain missing values. Industry/year effects and company-clustered errors except firm-average cross sections (industry effects, HC3 errors).
design.timing: Activity at t-1 or t predicts financial changes t to t+h for h=1,2,3. Activity at t+1 overlaps the outcome window: explicitly a contemporaneous diagnostic, not an advance forecast.
design.cross_section: Average eligible company-years within company; require at least three eligible years. Fit one observation per company, use industry effects and HC3.
design.within_between: Decompose activity and ghost measure into company means and annual deviations, including all four between/within products, decomposed controls, and industry/year effects.
design.minimum_coverage: At least 80 observations, 30 companies, and 3 years for panel/subgroup models; at least 50 companies for firm-average models. Report unestimable fits explicitly.
design.scaling: Winsorize financial changes and controls at original USD universe 1st/99th percentiles. Clip proxy log changes at eligible panel 1st/99th percentiles; sign rank follows original negative/zero/positive rule. Standardize recruitment proxy and controls for numerical stability without redefining ghost scores.
design.inference: Two-sided t tests. Holm and BH across every new recruitment-slope test, across every ghost-interaction test, and across every heterogeneity contrast. Joint required pattern is positive baseline and negative ghost interaction on the identical sample, with p=max(two-sided baseline p, two-sided interaction p); set joint p=1 if signs differ. Holm/BH also across all such pairs.
design.stability: Every nominal joint pattern will be rerun in both halves of one fixed company hash partition. These are internal stability checks, not untouched confirmation.
design.interpretation: A subgroup difference alone does not reproduce the full Lourie pattern. Do not interpret significance in one subgroup and absence in another as a significant difference. Use pooled triple-interaction contrasts.
design.reporting: Report all specifications, failures, coefficient uncertainty and adjustments. Preserve every previous result and the main separate-review validation.

hc3_singleton_amendment.reason: HC3 covariance is undefined for one-company industries with industry effects. These observations are perfectly absorbed and do not identify recruitment slopes.
hc3_singleton_amendment.action: Exclude one-company industries from firm-average cross sections only, record the count in each result, retain the initial failed fits, and rerun the fixed menu. No changes to ghost labels, subgroup rules, proxies, timing, or tests.
hc3_singleton_amendment.status: Numerical correction after first attempt, before corrected fits
